notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey there, Designers! ✧

Guess what? Your highly-anticipated update for Party Maker is finally here! Get ready for an enhanced gameplay experience, a new addition called the Festival of Love, and a Creative Mode to ignite your imagination!

Here's the rundown:
Access Creative Mode right from your office in the upcoming update.
Launch any level without worrying about tasks, demands, or budget constraints (we've got you covered with 100k). 
Unlock new decorations as you progress in the story mode.
After completing the first ballroom task, a Side Jobs tab appears on your laptop. There's a new order waiting for you at a Japanese school where you'll organize the Festival of Love. ♡ 
But wait, there's more ♡ Unlock fresh decorations to jazz up your events.
We've also fixed reported bugs and more!

We're ecstatic to announce this update, hoping it makes up for the time you've spent waiting (〜^∇^)〜.

See you at Party Maker!

[previewyoutube=IeHsQn1-9U4;full][/previewyoutube]

BIG UPDATE | 新しいレベルとクリエイティブモード

こんにちは、デザイナーの皆さん！ ✧

何だと思いますか？ Party Makerの待望のアップデートがついにここに登場しました！ ゲームプレイの体験を向上させる準備をし、フェスティバル・オブ・ラブと呼ばれる新しい要素、そしてあなたの想像力をかき立てるためのクリエイティブモードに備えてください！

以下が概要です：
次のアップデートでは、オフィスから直接クリエイティブモードにアクセスできます。
タスク、要求、予算の心配なく、どんなレベルでも開始できます。 ストーリーモードで進むにつれて新しい装飾をアンロックしていきます。
最初のバルのタスクを完了したら、ラップトップに「サイドジョブ」タブが表示されます。あなたがラブフェスティバルを開催する日本の学校で新しい注文が待っています。 ♡
でも待って、それだけでない ♡ 新しいイベントに華を添えるために新しい装飾をアンロックしてください。
また、報告されたバグを修正しました！

このアップデートが、お待ちいただいた時間を埋め合わせできることを願っています (〜^∇^)〜。

Party Makerでお会いしましょう！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125890/Party_Maker/

notes.title: Black Screen & HotFix
notes.notes:
Hi Designers

We want to let you know that the black screen bug after returning to the game has been fixed. So feel free to go back to working on your projects. We also fixed a few other bugs along the way.

-	Once you enter the laptop, you cannot return to the game.
-	Additional icons appeared on the computer without any function
-	The game does not count some achievements correctly.

In the near future, we will show you a new game mode, which you will know more about soon. We are also preparing something special for Valentine's Day.

Stay Tuned,

Forestlight Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125890/Party_Maker/

notes.title: Party Maker New Year's update
notes.notes:
We have been reading and listening to your feedback and we hear you! More enjoyment - you say. Why is it ending already? With the next update, we're adding the ability to replay all completed levels after finishing the game. So, you can return to your favorite spot and have another go, this time with all the decorations unlocked.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36658449/bf31e876ba3ae5778ed9ebd231fae746318ae900.jpg

At the beginning of the new year, we will also provide a brand-new location!

We can't wait for your new compositions. Be sure to share them with us.

Let’s stay in touch!

Forestlight Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1125890/Party_Maker/

notes.title: Wedding Designer Prologue - Release day stream and Screenshot competition
notes.notes:
Hello, Wedding Designer community!

Only one day left till the Wedding Designer Prologue release. To celebrate this wonderful occasion, we are announcing a big screenshot contest.

All you have to do is play Wedding Designer Prologue, and share with us some of the best screenshots you did while preparing for a party on the farm.

You can post your lovely shots to Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram with an obligatory tag #WeddingDesignerContest. Don't forget to tag us on your posts @forestlightgames on Facebook, @ForestlightG on Twitter, and @forestlight.games on Instagram

Best photos will be published on the game's Steam page, and their creators will also receive a Steam code for the Full Version of Wedding Designer! *

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/02f1340bc00bbdaf81a16229a9cba61de58f9123.jpg


But wait! There is more!

26th of May at 18:00 CEST we will host a special 1-hour developer stream, where you will be able to talk with us, see us playing the game, and ask questions that bother you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35499197/0b73830fe449772cd3739476066cdd713fceea11.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405810/Wedding_Designer_Prologue/

*Keys will be distributed on Wedding Designer release day.
